channel.title: Hashbeam
channel.description: Hashbeam reports crypto news: protocol upgrades, network security, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and market structure across blockchains and tokens.

item.title: Compare BTC-to-ETH quotes by the ETH delivered
item.description: A BTC-to-ETH quote is useful only when it shows the net ETH for the same BTC input, destination asset, fee treatment and execution assumptions.

item.title: Set a Slippage Ceiling for Treasury Swaps
item.description: Set a treasury swap ceiling by translating the maximum acceptable execution loss into a minimum output, then checking the route, fees and failure behavior.

item.title: Ledger details CryptoBilis wallet implant’s LTE seed theft
item.description: Ledger says an implant in CryptoBilis-sold devices read recovery phrases from the screen during setup and sent them over LTE, exposing wallets beyond the Secure Element.

item.title: When a Cross-Chain Swap Expires, What Happens to the Funds?
item.description: A swap deadline changes which settlement and refund actions remain valid; it does not itself move tokens, and the refund path depends on the protocol’s contract.

item.title: Why Cross-Chain Network Fees Change Before You Submit
item.description: Cross-chain fee estimates move as gas markets, route costs and destination execution change; inspect each fee component and refresh the quote before signing.

item.title: Reserve Destination Gas Before a Treasury Bridge
item.description: A bridge can deliver treasury assets without funding the destination wallet’s next transaction; reserve the chain’s native gas asset against a defined operating plan.

item.title: How to Choose a Safe Test Amount for a Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: A useful cross-chain test is the smallest amount that can cover both chains’ fees, confirm the route and destination, and reveal failures without wasting value.

item.title: Federated Hermes plans tokenized fund shares with Prometheum
item.description: Federated Hermes plans tokenized fund shares for early 2027 with Prometheum handling brokerage, custody and clearing; the fund and blockchain remain undisclosed.

item.title: Monero bridge spreads, limits and settlement in 2026
item.description: A Monero bridge is not one protocol: the route determines who prices the swap, what can be recovered, when settlement is final and which limits apply.

item.title: Quickswap explained: what cross-chain integrators must model
item.description: Quickswap combines a cross-chain transfer and asset swap in one flow; integrators still need to model settlement, destination execution, and failure states.

item.title: Binance will close Pool and mining services on Nov. 10
item.description: Binance will end pool and cloud mining services Nov. 10, cutting off Stratum submissions and setting final reward calculations for eligible shares.

item.title: Standard Chartered launches RLUSD custody, plans LMAX collateral link
item.description: Standard Chartered launched RLUSD custody in Dubai; a planned LMAX link may let clients use tokens as collateral without moving them to the venue.

item.title: XRPL patches overflow flaw that could mint spendable XRP
item.description: XRPL’s 3.4.1 release blocks an order-book arithmetic overflow that could mint spendable XRP, after validators upgraded ahead of a public disclosure.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as CLARITY Act stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six receiving $1 million each, as the Senate’s CLARITY Act stall leaves market rules unresolved.

item.title: ESMA sets three-month deadline for legacy stablecoin exposures
item.description: ESMA says EU supervisors should end services for non-MiCA stablecoins, requiring legacy exposures cleared within three months while narrowly allowing exits.

item.title: Fairshake targets 32 House races with crypto spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for November support, including six with $1 million each, after Senate efforts to advance the CLARITY Act failed.

item.title: ESMA tests tokenised collateral against CCP default risks
item.description: ESMA has opened a consultation on tokenised assets in CCP collateral workflows, putting default-time liquidity, legal enforceability and settlement finality in focus.

item.title: Thailand SEC sets Oct. 16 start for bitcoin, ether ETF rules
item.description: Thailand’s SEC has issued 11 rules effective Oct. 16, opening local exchange-traded bitcoin and ether funds under passive, custody and investor-protection requirements.

item.title: New York Permanently Bars Alex Mashinsky From Crypto Industries
item.description: New York’s settlement permanently bars Alex Mashinsky from securities, commodities and crypto business, with up to $35 million tied to federal forfeiture and prison terms.

item.title: ESMA Sets Three-Month Wind-Down for Non-MiCA Stablecoins
item.description: ESMA says EU crypto providers should block access to stablecoins outside MiCA and regulators should resolve existing client exposures within three months.
